items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Peewee Russel called Bud Freeman and me up one afternoon... I want you to meet Jack Teagarden.

ctx.x: beautifully. A good reader, good execution. Great facility on his instrument. Good tone and I think a dedicated musician you know.

But the thing that happened with the Ben Pollack band was we were playing at the Park Central Hotel at the time and we hadn't gone into the Park Central yet. We just finished at another place. We were on one night stands, that's right. Atlantic City and all around and so forth. And came back to New York and Peewee Russel called Bud Freeman and me up one afternoon. And he said, hey you guys, come on down here to Uptons' Speak Easy. It was a speak easy down on 50th Street, 51st I mean and Broadway and 7th. He says…

Now we said, now watch it Pete, be careful. So he said, come on down here and find out. And so we got down there and he says I want you to meet Jack Teagarden. He's from down Texas way, Oklahoma and Texas, and Jack had a cap in his hand and was sitting there drinking and he had his trombone and a cloth case.
